# software id = <redacted-by-obi>
#
# model = CRS328-24P-4S+
# serial number = EC7CC56DD38C
/interface bridge add name=bridge port-cost-mode=short vlan-filtering=yes
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether4 ] name=ether4-edgepower
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether11 ] name=ether11-camera
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether17 ] name=ether17-unifi-tower
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether19 ] name=ether19-unifi-creosote-redwood
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether21 ] name=ether21-ap-gas-station
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=ether24 ] name=ether24-lodgepole
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=sfp-sfpplus1 ] name=sfp-sfpplus1-yew-gw-a
/interface ethernet set [ find default-name=sfp-sfpplus2 ] name=sfp-sfpplus2-yew-gw-b
/interface vlan add interface=bridge name=vlan104-mgmt vlan-id=104
/interface bonding add mode=802.3ad name=bond-yew-gw slaves=sfp-sfpplus1-yew-gw-a,sfp-sfpplus2-yew-gw-b transmit-hash-policy=layer-2-and-3
/interface lte apn set [ find default=yes ] ip-type=ipv4 use-network-apn=no
/interface wireless security-profiles set [ find default=yes ] supplicant-identity=MikroTik
/ip smb users set [ find default=yes ] disabled=yes
/port set 0 name=serial0
/system logging action set 0 memory-lines=65535
/system logging action set 3 remote=172.18.84.101
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether1 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether2 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether3 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 tag-stacking=yes
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether4-edgepower internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=104
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether5 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether6 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether7 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether8 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether9 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether10 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether11-camera internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=104
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether12 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether13 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether14 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether15 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether16 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether17-unifi-tower internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether18 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether19-unifi-creosote-redwood internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether20 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether21-ap-gas-station internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10 pvid=501
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether22 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether23 internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=ether24-lodgepole internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/interface bridge port add bridge=bridge interface=bond-yew-gw internal-path-cost=10 path-cost=10
/ip firewall connection tracking set udp-timeout=10s
/ip neighbor discovery-settings set discover-interface-list=all
/ip settings set max-neighbor-entries=8192
/ipv6 settings set disable-ipv6=yes
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge,bond-yew-gw vlan-ids=104
/interface bridge vlan add bridge=bridge tagged=bridge,bond-yew-gw vlan-ids=501
/interface ovpn-server server add auth=sha1,md5 mac-address=02:EA:B0:26:FD:C7 name=ovpn-server1
/ip address add address=172.26.4.66/27 disabled=yes interface=bridge network=172.26.4.64
/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan104-mgmt
/ip dns set servers=198.51.100.1
/ip ipsec profile set [ find default=yes ] dpd-interval=2m dpd-maximum-failures=5
/ip smb shares set [ find default=yes ] directory=/flash/pub
/ip ssh set always-allow-password-login=yes forwarding-enabled=both
/routing bfd configuration add disabled=no
/system clock set time-zone-autodetect=no time-zone-name=US/Pacific
/system identity set name=yew-sw
/system logging add disabled=yes topics=stp
/system logging add action=remote topics=info
/system logging add action=remote topics=warning
/system logging add action=remote topics=error
/system logging add action=disk topics=info
/system logging add action=disk topics=warning
/system logging add action=disk topics=error
/system ntp client set enabled=yes
/system ntp client servers add address=pool.ntp.org
/system package update set channel=long-term
/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
/system scheduler add name=auto-upgrade on-event=":local copyright \"\A9 2021 Stuart Schneider, all rights reserved\";\r\
    \n\r\
    \n:delay 1500ms;\r\
    \n:log info \"auto-upgrade: Checking for firmware upgrade\";\r\
    \n:local current [/system routerboard get current-firmware];\r\
    \n:local upgrade [/system routerboard get upgrade-firmware];\r\
    \n:if (\$current!=\$upgrade) do={\r\
    \n        :log info \"auto-upgrade: Firmware upgrade needed (from \$current to \$upgrade), applying\";\r\
    \n        /system routerboard upgrade\r\
    \n        :delay 3500ms;\r\
    \n        :log info \"auto-upgrade: Rebooting to apply firmware upgrade\";\r\
    \n        /system reboot\r\
    \n} else={\r\
    \n        :log info \"auto-upgrade: Firmware is up to date (version \$current)\";\r\
    \n}\r\
    \n" policy=ftp,reboot,read,write,policy,test,password,sniff,sensitive,romon start-time=startup
/tool romon set enabled=yes
/tool sniffer set file-name=yew-sw.pcap filter-interface=ether11-camera filter-stream=yes streaming-enabled=yes streaming-server=172.31.185.152
